description: Find companies worldwide in the Global LEI Index (GLEIF): legal name, LEI, jurisdiction, legal form, register number and authority, legal and headquarters address, status and founding date. Search by name (optionally filtered by country) or fetch one LEI. Params: name or lei (one required), country (ISO2), limit (1 to 20, default 5). Price: $0.006 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"name":"Siemens","country":"DE","limit":3}.

country.description: ISO2 country of the legal address
